newsitem.title: UK: UK shares open lower despite Norwich debut.
newsitem.headline: UK shares open lower despite Norwich debut.

text.p: UK shares opened lower on Monday, as an impressive stock market debut for Norwich Union and another blistering rally in New York on Friday, failed to outweigh nerves ahead of the government's first Budget and the EU summit.
The FTSE 100 index of leading UK shares fell 14.5 points to 4,768.6 by 0740 GMT. Declining stocks outpaced gainers by three-to-one.
"People are starting to get nervous," one dealer said. "Trade will be very thin." The FTSE had risen three percent last week, setting three all-time closing highs.
